_comment: Ep.001 — Gmail-to-CRM lead capture agent. Numbers are placeholders from _ideas.md row 001 — replace with your real before/after before recording.

cues.text: This ran my inbox for three weeks. I didn't touch it once.
Every lead email, copied into the C-R-M by hand. Forty-five minutes a day, gone.
So I built an agent that reads the email, pulls out the contact and what they actually want, and drops a clean row straight into the C-R-M.
Watch — email comes in, the agent reads it, tags the intent, and the C-R-M row appears with the contact already filled in. It even drafts the first reply for me to approve.
Forty-five minutes a day down to about two minutes of review. That's four hours a week back.
If your inbox looks like mine did — comment AUTOMATE and I'll send you the workflow breakdown.
